Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

Robinhood’s Customer Experience team plays a critical role in Democratizing Finance for All. Our customer experience team supports customers across a wide range of account needs, delivering timely, accurate, and empathetic support across multiple channels.

As a Customer Experience Team Lead within the Executive Office, you will serve as a technical leader and subject matter expert, helping our team deliver accurate, timely, and thoughtful resolutions to complex customer concerns. You will provide hands-on coaching, strengthen investigative and problem-solving capabilities, and support consistent execution of our quality and regulatory standards. 

You’ll partner closely with the Customer Experience Manager to drive operational excellence, manage case priorities, and identify opportunities to improve processes and customer outcomes. This role requires strong judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to navigate sensitive situations while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Schedule & Work Environment
This role is based in our Westlake, TX office or Denver, CO, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days a week.

The team operates on a 7:00am - 10:00pm EST schedule. Employees will work either five 8-hour shifts or four 10-hour shifts per week, depending on business needs. Specific schedules will be determined after hire.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Serve as a technical subject matter expert, providing guidance and coaching on complex customer complaints, investigations, and escalations.
  • Develop team capabilities through hands-on coaching, case reviews, knowledge sharing, and actionable feedback that strengthens quality, judgment, and resolution effectiveness.
  • Support daily operations by monitoring case queues, prioritizing time-sensitive matters, and ensuring cases are assigned, progressed, and resolved within established service-level and regulatory timelines.
  • Provide guidance on sensitive or high-risk customer situations, partnering with Compliance, Legal, and other internal teams to support appropriate resolution.
  • Monitor case quality, productivity, and operational trends, identifying opportunities to improve team performance, processes, and the customer experience.
  • Partner with the Customer Experience Manager to reinforce operational standards, drive accountability, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Lead by example by directly managing complex customer cases and supporting the team during periods of increased volume or operational need.

What you bring

  • Active FINRA Series 7, Series 63, Series 9/10 OR Series 24 preferred. Ability to obtain Series 3 within 120 days)
  • Experience handling complex customer concerns, escalations, or complaints within a financial services or regulated environment.
  • Strong technical coaching and leadership skills, with the ability to develop others through feedback, guidance, and knowledge sharing.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly and professionally in sensitive or high-stakes situations.
  • Strong investigative, analytical, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to balance customer outcomes, regulatory requirements, and business priorities.
  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities, meet critical deadlines, and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and influence outcomes without direct authority.
  • Flexibility in scheduling to support business needs.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. 
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!

About Bitdeer

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for Bitcoin mining and AI cloud.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers. Apart from designing industry-leading ASIC chips and manufacturing mining rigs, the Group handles complex processes involved in computing across the value chain. This includes equipment procurement, transport logistics, datacenter design and construction, equipment management, and network and facility operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with a high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer operates globally with a diversified 3 GW energy portfolio, and deploys Bitcoin mining and HPC datacenters in the United States, Bhutan, Norway, Canada, Malaysia, and Ethiopia.

We are seeking

We are seeking an AI Datacenter Construction Manager to lead on-site delivery of Bitdeer’s AI data center builds. Reporting to the VP, Data Center Construction, you will be Bitdeer’s senior representative on site, accountable for safety, schedule, quality, and cost from mobilization through energization, commissioning, and turnover.

You will manage the general contractor and trade partners day to day, coordinate discipline leads, and keep the site moving to plan. The ideal candidate has run large data center or mission-critical sites from the owner’s or general contractor’s side.

Location: Candidates will work on site as needed and should be based in one of the following areas, primarily in Texas and Ohio: Austin, TX; Rockdale, TX; Abilene, TX; Houston, TX; Dallas, TX; Massillon, OH; Clarington, OH; Columbus, OH; Akron, OH; or Pittsburgh, PA.

What you will be responsible for

Site Leadership

  • Owner’s Representative: Act as Bitdeer’s on-site lead and single point of accountability for the build.
  • Contractor Management: Direct the general contractor and trade partners on safety, quality, productivity, and schedule.
  • Daily Coordination: Run site coordination meetings, look-ahead planning, and site logistics.

Schedule & Cost

  • Schedule Delivery: Drive the site schedule and short-interval plans, and flag and recover critical-path slippage.
  • Cost Oversight: Review change requests, quantities, and pay applications with cost and procurement.
  • Progress Reporting: Report progress, risks, and issues to the VP, Data Center Construction and the TPM.

Safety & Quality

  • Site Safety: Enforce site safety plans with the EHS Manager and lead by example in the field.
  • Quality Control: Verify work against drawings and specifications with the QA/QC Manager.
  • Issue Resolution: Resolve RFIs and field issues quickly with design and engineering.

Interfaces & Turnover

  • Discipline Coordination: Coordinate civil, electrical/HV, mechanical, fiber, and ELV scopes on site.
  • Authorities & Utilities: Work with local authorities, inspectors, and utilities on permits, inspections, and site access.
  • Turnover: Support commissioning and deliver punch-list closure, as-builts, and turnover.

How you will stand out

  • Experience: 10+ years in construction management, including 5+ years leading data center or mission-critical sites.
  • Project Scale: Experience delivering large, fast-track builds with multiple concurrent trades.
  • Technical Breadth: Working knowledge of civil, structural, MEP, and commissioning on data center projects.
  • Field Leadership: Proven ability to manage general contractors and trade partners on site.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Certifications: Professional certifications such as OSHA 30-Hour, PMP, or CCM.
  • Site-Based Work: Willingness to be based on site and to travel to or relocate to active project locations.
  • Field Leadership: Earns respect from contractors and crews and leads from the front.
  • Decisiveness: Makes sound calls quickly when field conditions change.
  • Communication: Keeps leadership informed with clear, timely updates.
  • Accountability: Owns the outcome of the site end to end.

What you will experience working with us

  • A culture that values authenticity and diverse perspectives.
  • An inclusive, respectful environment with open workspaces and an energetic, start-up spirit.
  • A fast-growing company with opportunities to network with industry pioneers and enthusiasts.
  • The ability to contribute directly and make an impact on the future of the digital asset and AI computing industry.
  • Involvement in new projects and in developing processes/systems.
  • Personal accountability, autonomy, rapid growth, and learning opportunities.
  • Attractive benefits and development such as training and mentoring.

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Platform Sales team is a highly consultative, enterprise sales team that is responsible for some of Stripe’s largest and fastest growing partners. Stripe helps software platforms offer more value to their customers by embedding Stripe’s powerful payments technology into their solution. As a Platform Sales Manager, you will play a critical role on our go-to-market leadership bench - leading a team of AEs to make payments-as-a-service a competitive advantage for high-growth organizations in the UK.

What you’ll do

  • Drive sales growth through successful leadership, organizational planning, customer service and outstanding execution 
  • Oversee the expansion of Stripe’s footprint with global SaaS platforms in the UK
  • Make hiring decisions, honing our ideal candidate profile and onboarding strategy
  • Create structure and focus for GTM ideas and product sales campaigns that the product team is exploring. Drive execution and measurement. Analyze results and make recommendations for action in a timely manner.
  • Define key sales support mechanisms, processes, and programs to meet the rapid growth of the business and achieve revenue attainment and market development objectives
  • Build a world-class organization and write the playbook for the era of monetizing payments on platform

Responsibilities

  • Lead a team of sophisticated Existing Business, Platform AEs focused on expanding our global footprint with enterprise SaaS platforms in the UK
  • Drive deal strategy and partner across the business to ensure healthy pipeline, funnel conversion, win rate, and margin preservation across the portfolio
  • Effectively work cross-functionally across the organization to shape Stripe's product roadmap and drive best practices on selling and forecasting
  • Engage with the largest strategic opportunities, leading executive relationships 
  • Being accountable for delivering revenue growth

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 8-10+ years of relevant closing sales experience with enterprise customers/large users
  • 5+ years of people management experience
  • Ability to hire, coach, and motivate a high-performance sales team
  • Ability to articulate complex, technical concepts and translate them into business-relevant terms
  • Demonstrated quantitative and analytical skills

Preferred qualifications 

  • Thrives in fast-paced settings with a high-level of autonomy and can create clarity and structure 
  • A knack for working well with a wide range of stakeholders, both internally and externally
  • Experience scoping and managing strategic projects with input from cross-functional teams
  • Prior experience in financial services, the payments industry, or with the card networks

About Stripe

Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. About the team

The UI Platform team, known as Sail, builds the foundations that support Stripe’s Dashboard and many of Stripe’s other user interfaces. The Sail UI team owns Stripe’s design system, helping Stripe engineers create consistent, accessible, performant, and high-quality experiences at scale.

We build and maintain reusable components, design tokens, theming capabilities, documentation, and developer tooling used by engineers and designers across Stripe. We are currently focused on two major projects. First, we are building Sail for Agents: the generation infrastructure, documentation systems, agent integrations, and automated quality checks that help AI coding agents build high-quality Stripe interfaces safely and consistently at scale. Second, we are evolving the visual language of the Dashboard, one of Stripe’s largest UI surfaces, while modernizing its underlying codebase.

What you’ll do

As a Frontend Engineer on the Sail UI team, you’ll help build and evolve Stripe’s design system and the tools that enable engineers and AI coding agents to create high-quality user interfaces. You’ll independently drive frontend projects from problem definition through rollout, working closely with designers, product engineers, and other Sail engineers. Your work will range from reusable components, themes, and documentation to agentic tooling, automated quality checks, and modernizing the foundations of Stripe’s Dashboard.

Responsibilities

  • Take end-to-end ownership of software projects, independently scoping problems and carrying solutions through design, implementation, testing, and rollout
  • Build and maintain accessible, performant, and well-tested components, themes, and frontend APIs used across Stripe
  • Build tooling, documentation, and automated quality checks that help engineers and AI coding agents use Sail effectively and meet Stripe’s UI quality bar
  • Partner with product designers and engineers to understand their needs and turn recurring UI patterns into reusable design-system capabilities
  • Help evolve the visual language of Stripe’s Dashboard while modernizing its underlying codebase and migrating legacy UI patterns
  • Improve the accessibility, internationalization, observability, performance, reliability, and developer experience of the design system
  • Contribute thoughtful code reviews, technical discussions, and documentation that improve the quality of the team’s work

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Fluency in using AI-assisted and agentic development tools as part of day-to-day software engineering, including critically reviewing, validating, and improving generated code
  • 2+ years of professional frontend engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience, building, shipping, and debugging web applications
  • Strong knowledge of modern frontend technologies and frameworks, including browser fundamentals, responsive design, and accessibility
  • Ability to independently scope and deliver open-ended frontend projects, making practical technical and product tradeoffs with limited oversight
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with attention to testing, maintainability, and the quality of the resulting user experience
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with designers, product engineers, and other partners

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience working on a design system, frontend platform, or shared component library
  • Experience with developer tooling such as build tools, package managers, codemods, lint rules, or large monorepos
  • Experience building tools, integrations, or automated evaluation and quality systems for AI coding agents
  • Experience using documentation, developer feedback, or adoption data to improve a developer-facing product

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Team

Regulatory Change sits within OKX's central Compliance function, with a global mandate covering how OKX anticipates, shapes, and responds to regulatory developments across all markets in which we operate. The team acts as a strategic partner to the business and Compliance teams, translating the regulatory landscape into clear guidance and action.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a Head of Regulatory Change & Policy to own and drive the regulatory change agenda globally. This person will bring vision, strategic judgment, as well as the ability to execute, translating a complex, fast-moving regulatory landscape into a clear strategy that protects and enables the business.
You will need to operate across multiple dimensions simultaneously: understanding our product landscape deeply to assess regulatory impact, engaging credibly with regulators and industry bodies, and building internal alignment across legal, risk, and local compliance teams. You will also build and lead a team, establishing the processes and judgment that junior team members will execute against over time.
This position calls for a seasoned regulatory change leader with a demonstrated track record of owning a comparable mandate — prior experience in a similar role in a complex matrix organization is essential.
 
 

What You’ll Be Doing

    • Regulatory change: own Compliance’s regulatory change log, assess the implications and business impact of evolving regulatory requirements on OKX's product landscape and partner with the Change Management team to ensure regulatory change is translated into business-ready action and the relevant policy framework is put into place (assign policy owner, deadline and feed content into Compliance obligation register)
    • In coordination with internal Risk and Compliance stakeholders manage, oversee and maintain a global regulatory obligations mapping and horizon scanning capability
    • Support local Compliance Teams, where required, with building and maintaining relationships with regulators and policymakers and in representing OKX in industry consultations and regulatory engagement efforts to ensure aligned positions across jurisdictions
    • Build out the Regulatory Change function, with the potential to add one compliance analyst within the first six months, subject to the function demonstrating measurable output and business value.
    • Set the operating model, priorities, and quality bar for the function
    • Coach and develop team members as the function scales from strategy design into steady-state execution
    • Build strong, trusted working relationships with Legal, Risk, and local Compliance teams across regions
 

What We Look For In You

    • Significant experience (at least 10+ years) in regulatory change, regulatory affairs, or a comparable senior compliance/ policy role, ideally within crypto, fintech, or another heavily regulated financial sector
    • Demonstrated experience building or significantly reshaping a regulatory change function, not just operating within an existing one
    • Global exposure to crypto-specific regulation, with working knowledge of multiple regulatory regimes
    • Track record of influencing senior internal stakeholders (Legal, Risk, Compliance) without formal authority over them
    • Experience building and leading a team, including hiring and developing junior talent
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable operating at executive level internally and externally
    • Pragmatic, execution-oriented mindset — able to move from strategic vision to operational detail
  •  

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Territory Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square's mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most.

This is a field-driven, execution-focused role designed for individuals who thrive in dynamic, demanding environments. You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.

You will serve as Square's presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square's visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.

If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

You will:

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

  • Spend ~80% of your week in the field — walking your territory, engaging local businesses, and driving 50–60 targeted business visits each week.
  • Run a full-cycle, self-sourced sales motion: generate leads, identify needs, deliver compelling demos, and close deals across Square's full product suite.

Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with local sellers by being present, reliable, and value-driven.
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and fast time-to-value for new sellers.
  • Implement a disciplined referral strategy to turn every new customer into future opportunities.

Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up

  • Develop a repeatable top-of-funnel engine through door-to-door outreach, community engagement, events, networking, and targeted partnerships.
  • Work with channel partners to generate a consistent, high-quality referral stream that grows over time.

Master your verticals and sell with precision

  • Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.
  • Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout the sales cycle.

Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment

  • Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.
  • Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.
  • Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

You have:

  • Experience exceeding sales targets, selling a diverse ecosystem of products, and closing complex deals
  • Ability to drive deals independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Business development experience (e.g. hunting and cold calling)

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.
Responsibilities
  • Routine Data Support: Leverage big data technologies to build a structured data delivery system for Compliance, Trading, and other business teams; ensure timely, accurate, and traceable data outputs, and maintain the team's existing data development workflows.
  • Analytics System Development: Develop analytical systems and monitoring dashboards for business teams; produce data reports to support performance attribution and data-driven operational oversight.
  • Data Asset Governance: Author application-layer data warehouse documentation, establish field-level data standards, and lead company-wide data asset management.
  • Data Agent Development: Build data agents (e.g., MCP Skills) to automate data retrieval and analysis workflows, improving team productivity.
  • Data Sourcing & Procurement: Build efficient, real-time data collection systems to scrape or procure the data resources the team needs — including but not limited to web scraping, procured API ingestion, and management of various procured accounts.
Requirements
  • Strong Python skills for data analysis and modeling (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib, PyTorch, TensorFlow); solid coding fundamentals.

  • Strong SQL skills, capable of complex queries and data modeling independently.
  • Experienced with AI coding tools (e.g., Codex, Claude Code, Kilo Code); able to integrate AI into daily workflows — and not just "vibe coding."
  • Familiar with Git and standard version control practices.
  • Working knowledge of Java and mainstream frameworks (e.g., Spring / Spring Boot), and of container-based deployment (Docker / Kubernetes).
Preferred
  • GitHub open-source contributions (self-written or AI-assisted both acceptable; any domain: scrapers, full-stack, tooling, etc.).
  • Experience building autonomous agents — LLM-based automation, conversational systems, MCP Servers, etc.
  • Practical experience in machine learning, deep learning, time-series modeling, anomaly detection, etc.

Great stories start with extraordinary people.

We’re bringing together exceptional creative talent to tell the stories of people shaping the future. Work alongside people who raise your standards, champion your ideas, and give you room to do the best work of your career.

Story inspires science. Science makes story real.

Your Story

We're looking for a Head of Production to lead and build the production operation at Story.

Story produces high-end commercial and branded content for some of the world's most ambitious companies, alongside a growing slate of original scripted fiction and nonfiction projects. You'll oversee production across both sides of the business, from commercial campaigns and documentaries to original films and series.

You know how to make ambitious work happen. You've produced everything from large-scale commercial shoots to scrappy, independent productions, and you know how to get exceptional results regardless of the budget.

You're relentless, resourceful, and don't take no for an answer. When a location falls through, a budget gets cut, or a timeline seems impossible, you're the person who finds a way forward.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll lead our producers, build exceptional crews, oversee budgets, and work closely with our creative team to bring ambitious ideas to life. We need someone who can build a world-class production operation while still being willing to roll up their sleeves and personally tackle the hardest challenges.

What You'll Own

  • Lead production at Story. Oversee our commercial productions, ensuring projects deliver exceptional work on time and on budget.

  • Build and lead the team. Hire, mentor, and manage producers and production staff. Establish a culture of ownership, resourcefulness, and high standards.

  • Make the impossible happen. Find creative solutions to difficult production challenges. Open doors, push through obstacles, and figure out how to accomplish things others might consider impossible.

  • Manage multiple productions. Balance competing schedules, budgets, and resources across several projects running simultaneously. Know where things stand and where your attention is needed.

  • Own production budgets. Oversee budgeting, cost control, vendor negotiations, and profitability across projects. Know where to invest and where to get creative.

  • Build our production network. Develop relationships with exceptional crew, vendors, locations, and production partners across the country and internationally.

  • Scale our production capabilities. Build systems, workflows, and processes that allow Story to take on more ambitious work without sacrificing quality or efficiency.

  • Partner with creative leadership. Work closely with directors, cinematographers, writers, and the creative team to translate ambitious concepts into executable production plans.

  • Get hands-on. Step in to personally lead complex shoots, solve critical problems, and support the team wherever you're needed.

You're the Right Person If

  • You have extensive experience producing high-end commercials, branded content, documentaries, or scripted film and television productions, including experience leading teams.

  • You understand the different demands of client-driven commercial work and original film and television production.

  • You've managed both large-budget productions and lean, independent shoots. You know how to succeed in both environments.

  • You're exceptionally resourceful. When someone tells you something can't be done, your first instinct is to figure out how.

  • You've overseen multiple productions simultaneously and know how to prioritize people, budgets, and resources.

  • You're a strong leader who knows how to hire great people, delegate effectively, and hold teams to high standards.

  • You have deep experience managing production budgets, negotiating with vendors, and protecting project profitability.

  • You have a strong network of trusted crew, production partners, and vendors.

  • You're highly organized and know how to build systems that make production more efficient without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.

  • You have strong creative instincts and understand what it takes to make exceptional work.

  • You're calm under pressure, decisive when things go wrong, and willing to take responsibility for the outcome.

  • You're based in the SF Bay Area or willing to relocate.

What Sets You Apart

You're a builder, not just a manager. You want to create a production operation that gets better with every project. You can establish the systems, hire the right people, and set the standards that make great work repeatable.

You're relentlessly resourceful. You've made ambitious work happen with limited time, money, and resources. You know who to call, how to negotiate, and when to find a completely different approach.

You can think big and operate small. You're comfortable leading a major commercial production, but you're equally capable of assembling a small crew and making something exceptional happen in a matter of days.

You have great taste. You understand what separates good work from extraordinary work. You protect the creative vision while finding practical ways to execute it.

You lead from the front. You don't just oversee spreadsheets and schedules. You get involved, solve problems, support your producers, and take pride in everything Story puts into the world.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $170,000 – $255,000. Your final offer will depend on your experience, skills and level.
